text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Page fired -> service=inference-canary severity=critical rule=service-5xx-spike
pagerduty: PagerDuty incident INC-2026-0459 triggered, on-call: @cami (primary) — escalation policy: eng-oncall -> eng-sre -> eng-runtime

cami: got it, acking now. investigating.

cami: quick summary? what broke for users? @sanjay ? @olga ?

sanjay: noticed in rollout dashboards — canary (v2026.03.12b) at 10% traffic. embedding requests returning 5xx on ~12% of attempts for routes using quantized-model-2. p99 latency spiked to 3.2s.

olga: support started seeing an uptick in customer tickets from two enterprise customers on dedicated pools — consistent 502s when requesting embeddings. No widespread support-bot reports yet.

matt: logs show repeated NaN exceptions in kernel-run for model-quantizer plugin on GPU nodes: stack snippet: ```
E 2026-03-12T22:14:01Z kernel_exec.cu: line 342: compute_attn: NaN detected in kv cache multiply
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File \"/srv/runtime/inference/engine.py\", line 887, in forward
    out = run_kernel(... )
```

lina: that matches the build we pushed — new fused attention kernel landed in the canary image. looks like a quant-path regression.

cami: acked incident at 1779998901. assigning to eng-runtime for quick rollback. @lina you up for rollback?

lina: on it. prepping rollback plan: 1) flip feature flag to route canary traffic to stable quant path, 2) scale canary down to 0% if flag flip doesn't clear, 3) rollback deployment if needed.

ryan: note — feature flag name is ff.routing:canary_quant_fuse (ops console). command I use: `redwoodctl flags set ff.routing:canary_quant_fuse false --env=prod`

lina: doing flag flip now. `redwoodctl flags set ff.routing:canary_quant_fuse false --env=prod` -> response: OK queued.

incident-bot: Action log: flag-change request accepted by control-plane (req=0x9f2b)

matt: metrics updating — error rate dropping from 12% -> 4% in the canary slice over last 30s. latency p99 -> 1.1s.

olga: support: customers reporting partial relief, still a few 5xxs but severity reduced.

cami: good. keep monitoring for 10m. if errors <1% for 10m, keep rollout paused and open follow-up. else prepare full rollback.

lina: 60s after flag flip: error rate at 0.9% on canary traffic. I'm going to hold traffic at 10% but not advance and open a rollback patch for record. Creating PR to revert fused kernel change: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pulls/1421

matt: curious if any other services got hit — checking edge routing: nothing upstream. seems isolated to canary pool on dedicated GPU flavor g5x.

pagerduty: INC-2026-0459 status=acknowledged by cami at 1779998902.

cami: since flag flip improved things, no immediate rollback. plan: 1) pause rollout, 2) scale canary autoscaler min=1 max=3 to reduce blast radius, 3) schedule L1 postmortem with runtime and release owner. who owns rollout? @sanjay

sanjay: i do. i'll freeze the release and stop CI promotions. creating incident ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-2026-0459

ryan: for extra safety I've removed the canary auto-burst rule: `kubectl patch hpa inference-canary -n prod --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/maxReplicas","value":3}]'`

lina: adding note: we'll need a reproducer and to add an assert in kernel CI against NaNs. I'll create an RFC for guard checks.

olga: support: tagging affected tickets and notifying customers that mitigations are in place. drafting email for two customers on dedicated pools.

matt: full verification run: run a quick synthetic embedding sweep: `curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"quantized-2","input":"test"}' | jq -r '.error'` -> returns null for 200 samples.

incident-bot: Monitoring set: canary-error-rate threshold 2% for 10m -> continue watch.

cami: escalation rules: if errors rise >2% for 5m, auto-escalate to eng-sre lead. we have oncall handoff in 45m; i'll put a handoff note in the incident ticket and add @matt as secondary.

pagerduty: PagerDuty note: incident set to low-urgency post-mitigation at 1779999150 by cami.

lina: next steps: 1) revert fused attention in next patch, 2) add NaN guard in kernel runtime CI, 3) run extended canary in staging with dedicated hardware. will assign tasks in PR.

sanjay: i'll coordinate release freeze and customer comms.

cami: final: condition green for now. keeping thread open for follow-up. if no regressions in 3h we'll close. @olga please confirm customer notifications sent.

olga: email sent to affected customers at 1779999500.

cami: closing note: handoff to Matt for overnight watch. Matt you're the named oncall for the next 3h — if anything flares, escalate to eng-sre lead.

matt: acknowledged. thanks all. creating post-incident checklist in RI-2026-0459.

pagerduty: INC-2026-0459 status=monitoring -> awaiting close.

incident-bot: Thread ended by cami at 1779999650
